get_departures.description: Get the departures from a Vienna station in the next 70 minutes, soonest first: each line, where it is going, the platform, the minutes until it leaves, the live and timetabled times and the delay, and whether the vehicle is step-free. Also lists the disruptions and elevator outages at the station.

parameters.description: The station to leave from. Pick it from the list, or type its name, its number (8 digits starting 60, e.g. 60201198) or one stop's number (e.g. 4116).
parameters.name: station

parameters.description: Only departures of these lines, e.g. U1. Leave blank for every line.
parameters.name: lines

barrier_free.description: True when the vehicle is step-free, suitable for wheelchairs and prams.

news.description:
Bauarbeiten
Wegen Straßenbauarbeiten in der Knödelhüttenstraße wird die Linie 52A umgeleitet.
Zeitraum:
Ab Donnerstag, 5. November 2026, etwa 07:00 Uhr für etwa drei Wochen.
Maßnahmen:
Linie 52A in Richtung Bhf. Hütteldorf S U:
Umleitung ab Knödelhüttenstraße # Haspelmeistergasse über Haspelmeistergasse - Hüttelbergstraße.
Aufgelassene Haltestellen:
- Haspelmeistergasse (Knödelhüttenstraße 23)
- Edenstraße (Knödelhüttenstraße gegenüber 48-50)
Ersatzhaltestellen:
- Haspelmeistergasse (Knödelhüttenstraße 25, provisorische Haltestelle)
- Ulmenstraße (Hüttelbergstraße 115, Haltestelle der Linien 43B und 52B)

description: Get live departures from any Vienna metro, tram or bus station, list Wiener Linien's disruptions, elevator outages, news and planned works, look up its lines, stations and routes, and run a workflow when a new disruption starts or an elevator goes out of service. No account or API key required.

wiener_linien_elevator_out_of_service_tr.description: Triggers once for each Wiener Linien elevator that goes out of service at the station or on the lines you choose, including planned maintenance when it begins. Elevators already out of service when you turn it on never trigger it

parameters.description: Only elevators at this station: pick it, or type its name or number. Leave blank for every station.
parameters.name: station

parameters.description: Only elevators to these lines' platforms, e.g. U6; separate several with commas. Leave blank for every line.
parameters.name: line

wiener_linien_new_disruption_trigger.description: Triggers once for each new service disruption Wiener Linien reports, such as a delay, a closure or a diversion, on the lines you choose, as soon as it is in effect. Disruptions already in effect when you turn it on never trigger it

parameters.description: Only disruptions on these lines, e.g. U6; separate several with commas. Leave blank for every line.
